dimension:catalogue-anchors/anchor-epoch.collapses: Per-occurrence anchor times are summarized by one half-open whole-second UTC interval.
dimension:catalogue-anchors/anchor-epoch.licenses: Stating in applicability the interval within which an occurrence's anchor time label must fall, for targets of general/event-locked-change.
dimension:catalogue-anchors/anchor-epoch.not_established: Any link from the interval to an anchor coordinate, a clock or a catalogue snapshot. The required restriction_sort names the class sort and no check reads it for a time interval.

estimand:instantiation:catalogue-anchors.collapses: Only the event-locked form is admitted, with no conditioning sorts.
estimand:instantiation:catalogue-anchors.licenses: Event-locked targets for this instantiation: an anchor rule, fixed lag windows and a measured response.
estimand:instantiation:catalogue-anchors.not_established: Control epochs, difference-in-differences, strata, superposed-epoch curves or any uncertainty model; each would be a new target.

instantiation:catalogue-anchors/halo-anc.collapses: The licence to anchor on this class and the choice of response bearer are joined in one admission.
instantiation:catalogue-anchors/halo-anc.licenses: Statistical-layer claims of general/event-locked-change with anchor catalogue-anchors/cdaw-halo-cme and response plasma-populations/near-earth-solar-wind.
instantiation:catalogue-anchors/halo-anc.not_established: That an anchored occurrence was Earth-directed, that the sampled plasma came from it, or that it changed the speed. The comparison is conditioned on an annotation.

sort:catalogue-anchors/cdaw-halo-cme.collapses: Records the CDAW SOHO/LASCO CME catalogue team marks Halo in the central position angle (CPA) column are one class. The catalogue's own description states the criterion, quoted as written: 'CMEs an apparent width of 360 deg are marked as Halo in the CPA column.' Evidence revision: https://cdaw.gsfc.nasa.gov/CME_list/catalog_description.htm as retrieved 2026-10-11T18:39:52Z, 19613 bytes, SHA-256 dc30ab9357df22dc31899ab9650c4502a8297e229d835ce68b65a98dbb46a357. The sublabels Halo (S), Halo (BA) and Halo (OA) described there are not distinguished. Source location, direction and the annotator's detection limits are collapsed.
sort:catalogue-anchors/cdaw-halo-cme.licenses: Naming this annotation-defined class as the anchor of an event-locked comparison. The sort admits the single term catalogue-class:cdaw-halo-cme; the kernel checks identifier syntax only. Membership is supplied per analysis by a held classification rule and anchor table.
sort:catalogue-anchors/cdaw-halo-cme.not_established: That a labelled record marks a physical or Earth-directed event; that the catalogue is complete; or which records are members: catalogue rows are revised in place and catalogue versions differ, so the pinned criterion fixes what the class means and not its membership. A changed documented criterion is a new class and needs a new identifier.
